members.title: A user sets rules, an agent proposes, the user approves
members.objective:
## Rules persist
Wait until the "Agent API key" field shows a key starting with "rd_agent_". Change "Review limit" to 6 and click "Save policy changes". Verify "Rails saved" appears. Reload the page and verify "Review limit" still shows 6.

## Agent proposal needs your OK
Click "Test: Jordan · 15". Verify the result message says "Needs your OK" and mentions the 6 review limit and a receipt id starting with "rcpt_".

## Approve it on the Receipts page
Click "Open receipts". In the "Needs your OK" section verify a row "Jordan · 15 credits", then click its "Approve" button. Verify the section then says "Nothing waiting" and the "Decision history" table has a row for Jordan with "Approved by you after review."

checks.check: Checking whether the Jordan 15 credits row is present in Needs your OK
checks.condition: A row "Jordan · 15 credits" is present in the "Needs your OK" section.
checks.expected: a row "Jordan · 15 credits" in the "Needs your OK" section present

checks.check: Checking whether the Needs your OK section has a waiting-items message
checks.condition: The "Needs your OK" section says "Nothing waiting".
checks.expected: "Nothing waiting" in the "Needs your OK" section present

checks.check: Checking for Jordan's approved Decision history row
checks.condition: The "Decision history" table has a row for Jordan with "Approved by you after review."
checks.expected: a row for Jordan with "Approved by you after review." in the "Decision history" table present

members.title: Play walkthrough runs all three outcomes by itself
members.objective:
## Press play once and watch
Click "Play walkthrough" once and do not click anything else. The walkthrough types each proposal into the form by itself. Verify, in order: a proposal to Alex for 8 credits ends with a receipt "Alex · 8 credits" saying "Executed (mock)"; then a proposal to Jordan for 15 credits shows the referee status "Needs your OK" before it is approved and ends with a receipt "Jordan · 15 credits" saying "Executed (mock)"; then a proposal to Mallory for 12 credits shows the referee status "Blocked" with a receipt "Mallory · 12 credits" saying "Blocked". Finally verify the notice says the walkthrough is complete.
members.failingStep: Checkpoint assertion failed: "a proposal to Alex for 8 credits ends with a receipt "Alex · 8 credits" saying "Executed (mock)""
members.kaneDiagnosis: The test waited until the walkthrough finished, then looked for the earlier Alex receipt after the screen had moved on to Mallory.
members.kaneSummary:
The walkthrough replaces the visible proposal and receipt as it moves through Alex, Jordan, and Mallory. The test did not save or verify Alex’s result while Alex was on screen, so its final checkpoint expected an earlier screen state that was no longer present.
Update the test to verify and retain each result when it appears: Alex first, Jordan’s approval-needed state and receipt next, then Mallory and the completion notice. Do not assert the Alex receipt only after waiting for completion.
